Section 6.01(a) imposes three distinct prohibitions sharing one lead-in: (i) incurring Indebtedness (Borrowers and Restricted Subsidiaries), (ii) issuing Disqualified Stock (Borrowers and any Restricted Subsidiary), and (iii) issuing Preferred Stock by a Restricted Subsidiary that is NOT a Guarantor. These are modeled as three separate PROHIBITION rules (p1/p2/p3) because their entity scopes differ (notably p3's Guarantor carve-out), even though they share the same proviso/exceptions structure.

The proviso in §6.01(a) creates three independent, unlimited-amount, ratio-gated permission baskets (rr1/rr2/rr3) keyed to the security classification of the debt/stock (pari passu Collateral, Junior Lien Priority Collateral, or unsecured). Each basket covers Indebtedness, Disqualified Stock and Preferred Stock alike, so it is referenced as an exception from all three of p1/p2/p3.

The §6.01(b) exceptions (Loan Documents debt, ABL Loan Documents debt, Fixed Incremental Amount debt, Existing Indebtedness) are drafted only in terms of 'Indebtedness' and were therefore only linked as exceptions to p1 (debt), not to p2 (Disqualified Stock) or p3 (Preferred Stock) - a deliberate scope-precision choice reflected in p2/p3's sufficiencyReasons.

The supplied operative excerpt of §6.01(b) ends at clause (3) ('Existing Indebtedness ... other than Indebtedness described in Section 6.01(b)(1);'); typical credit agreements of this kind continue with many further numbered exceptions (as evidenced by cross-references elsewhere in the retrieved dependency context to clauses like 6.01(b)(12)(b) and 6.01(b)(14)(e)(2)). Those further clauses are outside the source given for this compilation task and are not represented here.

Several external dependencies (Borrowing Base under the ABL Credit Agreement; the full Fixed Incremental Amount build-up components; Sections 2.19/2.22 full text) could not be fully resolved because the ABL Credit Agreement document is confirmed absent from this package and/or the relevant sections were only retrievable as bare headings - these gaps are reflected as PARTIAL sufficiency with explicit dependsOn/UNSUPPORTED nodes rather than being silently assumed.
